episode.title: The Nighttime Lights of Russia

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Ajay’s Journey With the Data

episode.tagline: Sometimes, the data just ain’t enough. What’s going on in Russia? In fact, what’s going on in Karnataka — and all the rest of the world? Can we glean some insights in alternative sources of data?
episode.about: In this episode, Ajay discusses his pioneering work in using nighttime lights data from satellites to get crucial insights about the world — most recently, Russia. Watch!
